svg.title: Lab 04 hub-and-spoke virtual network architecture for Solstice Analytics
svg.text: Solstice Analytics · rg-solstice-network · East US · as defined in Terraform (27 resource instances)
Lab 03 NSG, rules added in Lab 04
test point now, backup target in Lab 05
dev and prod are not peered; defense in depth
No VMs are managed by Terraform here.
A throwaway test VM is created and deleted
with the Azure CLI to prove isolation.
Default outbound access is off on this subnet,
so the empty subnet has no internet egress and
no NAT gateway. Test VMs use run-command.
prod and dev are not peered
peering is not transitive: no path via the hub
Hub peers with prod and with dev, two peering resources per pair.
Only compute, batch and hub ops reach the endpoint, on 443.
Hub ops can SSH to prod compute (110); the rest of the hub is denied.
Prod compute takes HTTP 80 from the internet and the health probe only.
Dev denies everything inbound and has no outbound internet access.
Hub and prod compute egress from their NAT gateways' static IPs.
No VM or endpoint has a public IP; nothing reaches them from
the internet except the load balancer on port 80.
